qs.s: The orchid family of flowers is the most ______ plant family found in nature. (DIVERSITY)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: diverse
qs.e: Cần một tính từ đứng trước danh từ "plant family".

qs.s: Vietnamese ______ of weddings, funerals, holidays, and rituals all attracted the village community. (CUSTOMARY)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: customs
qs.e: Customs là phong tục, phù hợp với weddings, funerals, holidays và rituals; costumes là trang phục.

qs.s: His paintings were so unique as to require no signature for ______. (IDENTITY)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: identification
qs.e: Sau giới từ "for" cần một danh từ.

qs.s: Dying languages and urbanization are threats to cultural ______. (IDENTIFICATION)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: identity
qs.e: Cụm danh từ "cultural identity" nghĩa là bản sắc văn hóa.

qs.s: We prefer to buy regional ______ from a small supermarket. (SPECIAL)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: specialties || specialities
qs.e: Sau tính từ "regional" cần danh từ số nhiều (đặc sản).

qs.s: Cycling has been gaining in ______ in many parts of Vietnam. (POPULAR)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: popularity
qs.e: Cụm từ "gain in popularity" nghĩa là trở nên phổ biến/nổi tiếng.

qs.s: The ______ of cultural diversity is evident in art, food, and music. (INFLUENTIAL)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: influence
qs.e: Sau mạn từ "The" cần một danh từ làm chủ ngữ.

qs.s: Complaining about the customs of another culture is both ______ and disrespectful. (CHILDHOOD)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: childish
qs.e: Childish mang nghĩa tiêu cực là trẻ con, thiếu chín chắn; childlike thường mang nghĩa tích cực.

qs.s: ______, this festival is celebrated with family gatherings, but in modern times, communities also participate together. (TRADITION)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: Traditionally
qs.e: Cần trạng từ đứng đầu câu bổ nghĩa cho cả câu.

qs.s: Selling souvenirs without a permit is considered ______ at the fair. (LEGALLY)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: illegal
qs.e: Cấu trúc consider + sth + adj (coi cái gì như thế nào).

qs.s: The festival was a success in many ______, attracting thousands of visitors. (RESPECTFUL)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: respects
qs.e: Cụm từ "in many respects" nghĩa là trên nhiều phương diện.

qs.s: Visiting a multicultural city gives you an opportunity to taste foods from all over the world. (CULTURE)
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: Visiting a culturally diverse city gives you an opportunity to taste foods from all over the world.
qs.e: Dùng culturally diverse để diễn đạt ý multicultural và biến đổi từ CULTURE.

qs.s: There was some confusion among the tourists due to the unfamiliar customs. (CONFUSE)
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: The unfamiliar customs confused some of the tourists.
qs.e: Đổi danh từ confusion thành động từ confused.

qs.s: We are now living in an increasingly connected world thanks to globalization. (CONNECTION)
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: Thanks to globalization, we are now living in a world with increasing connections.
qs.e: Đổi connected thành danh từ connections; giữ ý các mối liên kết ngày càng tăng.

qs.s: When Helen moved to Japan, she had to quickly assimilate a new language into her vocabulary. (ASSIMILATION)
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: When Helen moved to Japan, she had to quickly work on the assimilation of a new language into her vocabulary.
qs.e: Dùng danh từ assimilation thay cho động từ assimilate. Câu gốc hơi thiếu tự nhiên về cách diễn đạt.

qs.s: I arrived by train a moment ago.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: I have just arrived by train.
qs.e: A moment ago chuyển thành just với thì hiện tại hoàn thành; không dùng for a moment.

qs.s: As soon as he arrived home, it started to rain.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: No sooner had he arrived home than it started to rain.
qs.e: Cấu trúc No sooner + had + S + V3/ed + than + S + V2/ed.

qs.s: I had been instructed to drive out of town and I began to acquire confidence.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: After having been instructed to drive out of town, I began to acquire confidence.
qs.e: Giữ đủ cụm to drive out of town và dùng dạng bị động hoàn thành having been instructed.

qs.s: I have only ever felt frightened on one occasion.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: Only on one occasion have I ever felt frightened.
qs.e: Đảo ngữ với Only on one occasion + trợ động từ + S + V.

qs.s: I prefer reading books to watching TV.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: I would rather read books than watch TV.
qs.e: Cấu trúc would rather + V1 + than + V1.

qs.s: I'm thinking about my future.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: I'm giving thought to my future.
qs.e: Cụm từ give thought to sth nghĩa là suy nghĩ về cái gì.

qs.s: It's your duty to report this incident.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: You are supposed to report this incident.
qs.e: Cấu trúc be supposed to + V1 (có nhiệm vụ/trách nhiệm làm gì).

qs.s: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: Despite the rain, we went for a walk.
qs.e: Cấu trúc Despite + N/N-phrase, S + V.

qs.s: I had never seen such a beautiful sunset before.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: Never had I seen such a beautiful sunset before.
qs.e: Đảo ngữ với Never đứng đầu câu: Never + had + S + V3/ed.

qs.s: His kindness impressed me the most.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: What impressed me the most was his kindness.
qs.e: Cấu trúc câu nhấn mạnh với Mệnh đề quan hệ tự do (What clause).

qs.s: I suggest that we should leave early.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: I suggest leaving early.
qs.e: Cấu trúc suggest + V-ing.

qs.s: I didn't arrive in time to see her.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: I wasn't early enough to see her.
qs.e: Cấu trúc adj + enough + to V.

qs.s: Janet is the best tennis player in the club.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: No one in the club plays tennis better than Janet.
qs.e: Chuyển đổi từ so sánh nhất sang so sánh hơn với "No one".

qs.s: He didn't hurry, so he missed the train.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: If he had hurried, he wouldn't have missed the train.
qs.e: Câu điều kiện loại 3 diễn tả điều trái với thực tế trong quá khứ.

qs.s: I think it was about two in the morning when I returned home.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: It must have been about two in the morning when I returned home.
qs.e: Giữ about để bảo toàn mức độ ước lượng trong câu gốc.

qs.s: It is important to ________ misunderstandings calmly during cross-cultural events.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: deal with: giải quyết, đối phó với.

qs.s: There is a growing ________ to hold multicultural fairs, which provide an opportunity to showcase global diversity and attract more young people.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: trend: xu hướng.

qs.s: I attended the workshop to find ________ more about traditional handicrafts.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: find out: tìm hiểu, khám phá.

qs.s: ________ or custom of another culture fosters mutual respect.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: Understanding a belief or custom of another culture: việc hiểu một tín ngưỡng hay phong tục của nền văn hóa khác. A là phương án có mạo từ tự nhiên trong ngữ cảnh chung.

qs.s: Because of ________, it is the local identity that we should preserve by promoting traditions and sharing them with younger generations.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: globalization: sự toàn cầu hóa.

qs.s: Despite the ________ customs, the visitors adapted quickly by learning local traditions so that they could better appreciate the experience.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: unfamiliar: không quen thuộc, xa lạ.

qs.s: It was not until the professional chef shared his recipe that we realized why the dish was so ________ that everyone wanted a second serving.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: tasty: ngon miệng.

qs.s: While many people were familiar with the tradition of tug of war, having ________ in the game gave them a deeper understanding, and so they ________ its cultural meaning more.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: Participated in the game và appreciated its cultural meaning; participated phải đi với in (đã có trong câu).

qs.s: Unless you visit the fair, you won't see performances too unique to miss, and it is organized to promote ________.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: cultural diversity: sự đa dạng văn hóa.

qs.s: Respect for elders is a ________ of Asian cultures, while individualism is often seen in Western societies.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: A characteristic of Asian cultures: một đặc trưng của các nền văn hóa châu Á. Feature cũng có thể dùng, nên câu này chưa thật sự đơn nghĩa nếu giữ nguyên lựa chọn.

qs.s: Lighting candles on special occasions is a ________ that has been followed for generations.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: custom: phong tục.

qs.s: ________ causes confusion when people from different countries communicate.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: language barrier: rào cản ngôn ngữ.

qs.s: The event was successful ________ the hard work of local organizers.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: thanks to: nhờ vào, nhờ có.

qs.s: Interest in traditional crafts and cuisines is ________ among young people.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: on the rise: đang gia tăng.

qs.s: Many students struggle to ________ the unfamiliar customs in a foreign country.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: Catch on to unfamiliar customs: dần hiểu được những phong tục xa lạ. Keep up with là theo kịp sự thay đổi hoặc nhịp độ.

qs.s: When moving abroad, people sometimes ________ their sense of identity.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: lose one's sense of identity: mất đi bản sắc cá nhân/văn hóa.

qs.s: The organizers ________ the event seriously to ensure it showcased every aspect of the culture.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: take sth seriously: coi trọng/nghiêm túc với điều gì.

qs.s: Every dish has unique ________ that gives the dish and sauce its special flavor.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: Seasoning là danh từ không đếm được, phù hợp với has và gives ở số ít; ingredients số nhiều cần give.

qs.s: The performance ________ dance, music, and storytelling so seamlessly that the audience was mesmerized.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: blend: hòa trộn, kết hợp.

qs.s: She is a cultural ________. She is specialised in ethnic minority culture.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: specialist: chuyên gia.

qs.s: My neighbor is ________ photographer, let's ask him for ________ advice about color film.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: A photographer; advice là danh từ không đếm được nên không có mạo từ.

qs.s: In most ________ developed countries, up to 50% of ________ population enters higher education at some time in their lives.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: Developed countries dùng mạo từ rỗng Ø; population dùng "the population".

qs.s: After he left ________ University of Massachusetts, he went to ________ Indiana State University.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: The University of Massachusetts; Indiana State University không dùng mạo từ.

qs.s: He spent part of ________ afternoon telling them ________ news he could not tell them by telephone.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: Part of the afternoon và the news. Đã sửa lựa chọn A vốn thừa một thành phần.

qs.s: He teaches ________ piano and ________ violin.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: Khi nói dạy chơi nhạc cụ, dùng teach the piano and the violin. Đề cũ không có lựa chọn đúng.

qs.s: ________ professor Johns, ________ man whose new drug everyone is talking about refused ________ interview.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: Professor Johns không dùng mạo từ trước chức danh đi với tên riêng; the man xác định; an interview lần đầu đề cập.

qs.s: There isn't ________ airport near where I live, ________ nearest airport is 70 miles away.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: Lần đầu nhắc tới dùng "an", so sánh nhất dùng "the nearest".

qs.s: Would you rather live in ________ town or in ________ country.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: Cụm từ cố định: in a town, in the country.

qs.s: ________ most lively and energetic cultural performances take place in ________ heart of New York City.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: So sánh nhất dùng "The", cụm từ "in the heart of".

qs.s: ________ interesting cultural shock for travellers in Spain is ________ tradition of siestas in the afternoon.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: Một cú sốc văn hóa dùng "An", truyền thống cụ thể dùng "the".

qs.s: It is ________ unique cultural experience to attend ________ Rio de Janeiro Carnival in Brazil.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: "a unique" (âm /j/), tên lễ hội lớn dùng "the".

qs.s: Taiwan is ________ island. It is ________ largest island of ________ Republic of China.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: "an island", so sánh nhất "the largest", tên quốc gia dạng Republic dùng "the Republic of China".
